text:
The CSE Department laboratories run entirely on open-source software stacks,
are supported by high-speed internet connectivity and smart boards, and remain
accessible to students 24x7 for project and research work outside scheduled
practical sessions.

Facilities at a glance: Computer Vision Laboratory (120 computers) for computer
vision, image processing and real-time societal computing projects. Data Science
Laboratory (120 computers) for data science, analytics and hyperspectral imaging
research under the Centre of Excellence. Advanced Computing Laboratories
(high-performance GPU systems) for machine learning, neural networks and deep
learning workloads. Data Science and Analytics Laboratories for analytics
coursework and project-based learning. Robotics and Automation Laboratories for
embedded systems and automation projects. Smart Classrooms with smart-board-enabled
instruction and internet connectivity.

Common standards across all laboratories: round-the-clock (24x7) access for
students working on projects and research; high-speed internet connectivity in
every lab; smart boards installed for instruction and demonstration; all software
used is open source (licence-free and reproducible); uniform hardware configuration
across the two flagship labs (Computer Vision and Data Science) simplifying
deployment and administration.

Computer Vision Laboratory specification: 120 total computers, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS,
hardware model Micro-Star International Co. Ltd. MS-7E44, 12th Gen Intel Core
i5-12400F processors, 16.0 GiB memory. Software installed: Anaconda IDE, Jupyter,
Python, Eclipse IDE (all open source). Access is 24x7 with high-speed internet and
smart boards.

The Computer Vision Laboratory houses state-of-the-art computers with high
computing power used to solve real-time societal computing problems. The department
has received more than 13 real-time datasets from National Chung Cheng University,
Taiwan, under the Centre of Excellence (CoE). Projects currently in the
implementation phase in this lab: image-based SCR (Sickle-Cell Retinopathy)
detection; segmentation of garbage from drone imagery (quantity and
characterisation); VR by hologram; tracking Shirdi traffic (people, vehicles and
other objects); face, gender and age recognition using IR cameras.

Data Science Laboratory specification: 120 total computers, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS,
hardware model Micro-Star International Co. Ltd. MS-7E44, 12th Gen Intel Core
i5-12400F processors, 16.0 GiB memory. Software installed: Anaconda IDE, Jupyter,
Python, Eclipse IDE. Access is 24x7 with high-speed internet and a smart board.

The Data Science Laboratory hosts a Centre of Excellence sponsored by
HitSpectra Pvt. Ltd., Taiwan. Under this arrangement the laboratory has received 13
projects in the data science domain for processing in hyperspectral imaging with
colour science. Sponsoring partner: HitSpectra Pvt. Ltd., Taiwan. Research focus:
hyperspectral imaging with colour science. Datasets: 13+ real-time datasets from
National Chung Cheng University, Taiwan.

In addition to the two flagship laboratories (Computer Vision and Data
Science), the department maintains: Advanced Computing Laboratories with
high-performance GPUs; Robotics and Automation Laboratories. The laboratories
support three overlapping activities: regular subject practicals prescribed by the
curriculum; sponsored research work arising from the Centre of Excellence and the
Innovation Incubation Centre; and independent student projects including hackathon
and competition preparation. The 24x7 access policy exists specifically to make the
second and third categories possible without displacing scheduled teaching. Every
laboratory runs Ubuntu 24.04 LTS with an entirely open-source toolchain, including
Anaconda IDE, Jupyter, Python and Eclipse IDE, plus supporting libraries for
computer vision, machine learning and data analytics work.

title: Message from the Head of Department
text: Message from the Head of Department, Dr. Mahendra B. Gawali, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Sanjivani University. The 21st century is known as the technical era, and Computer Science is one of the core fields most impacted by this rapid transformation. Keeping these versatile needs in mind, Sanjivani University established the Department of Computer Science and Engineering in 2024. The department has highly qualified faculty members, fully digitally equipped classrooms, and state-of-the-art laboratories. It follows all rules and regulations laid down by NEP-2020, with flexibility to meet industry requirements and choice-based subject selection.
source: CSE Department Profile and Highlights, CSE-DEPT-2025-26

title: Department Vision
text: Vision of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering: To achieve global recognition in the field of computer science and engineering through an innovative curriculum and quality in Education, Research, Innovation and Entrepreneurship, producing effective leaders who serve societal challenges.
source: CSE Department Profile and Highlights, CSE-DEPT-2025-26

title: Department Mission
text: Mission of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering. First, to provide a platform for students to become industry ready technocrats as full stack developers, through a curriculum tailored to industry needs with a focus on complex problem-solving skills. Second, to impart high quality experiential learning in modern software tools and to meet the real-time requirements of industry. Third, to develop quality research, both national and international, enhancing learning through a strong research ecosystem. Fourth, to promote a supportive and positive community through initiatives that contribute to societal well-being and fulfil institutional social responsibility.
source: CSE Department Profile and Highlights, CSE-DEPT-2025-26
